dcterms:description: A dataset of human demonstrations collected from non-expert players interacting with the Atari 2600 games Pong, Freeway, and Beamrider. The dataset includes game states, actions taken, and rewards received during gameplay.
dcterms:title: Human Demonstration Dataset for Atari 2600 Games
